title: The Last Grind
description: A one-shot for a small party, playable in about 30 turns and usable with any rules.

premise.background: The flour mill at Greywater Bend has stopped, the village is hungry, and the miller has vanished.
premise.hook: Maren Holt meets the party at the ferry landing and asks them to restart the mill before the village runs out of bread.

locations.name: Greywater Bend
locations.summary: A hungry riverside village whose stone flour mill has stopped turning.

locations.name: The Ferry Landing
locations.summary: A rotting jetty across the reeds from the silent stone mill.

connections.description: Path from the jetty to the mill yard.
The reed path to the left of the jetty.

locations.name: The Mill Yard
locations.summary: Muddy yard outside the mill door with split sacks and a damp ledger on a nail.

connections.description: Through the mill door into the wheel room.

locations.name: The Wheel Room
locations.summary: Dimly lit room housing the jammed wheel shaft and the sluice lever.

connections.description: A narrow stair dropping into the cellar.

locations.name: The Reed Shrine
locations.summary: A ring of leaning stones in the reeds with a clay lamp and fresh bread.

connections.description: Return along the reed path to the jetty.

locations.name: The Miller's Cellar
locations.summary: Cold stone cellar below the mill that floods once the sluice lever is pulled.

connections.description: Up the narrow stair to the wheel room.

actors.name: Maren Holt
actors.summary: The miller's daughter, tired and quick to anger.
actors.motivation: Wants the mill running again to pay off her late mother's debt before the bailiff comes.

actors.name: Tobiah Reed
actors.summary: The mill's accountant, polite and unhurried.
actors.motivation: Wants the mill to fail so the bailiff will sell it cheaply to him.

actors.name: Wick
actors.summary: A dog-handler and hired guard, blunt and loyal to whoever pays.
actors.motivation: Wants his unpaid wages and a safe road out of the valley.

actors.name: Aldous Holt
actors.summary: The missing miller, found bound and gagged in the cellar.

scenes.title: Scene 1: The Ferry Landing
scenes.summary: Maren Holt meets the party at the jetty and asks them to restart the mill.
scenes.readAloud: The ferry bumps against a rotting jetty. Across the reeds a tall stone mill stands silent, its great wheel hanging still above brown water. A woman in a patched coat waits on the planks with her arms folded.
conditions: If the party arrives after dark, Maren is absent and Scene 2 begins with the gate already open.

branches.description: Proceed from the jetty to the mill yard.
Follow the reed path to the left of the jetty toward the shrine.

scenes.title: Scene 2: The Mill Yard
scenes.summary: The party examines the abandoned cart, split flour sacks, and damp ledger.
scenes.readAloud: Sacks lie split open across the yard, spilling grey powder. A cart has been dragged through the mud and abandoned. Beside the mill door hangs a ledger on a nail, its pages swollen with damp.
conditions: If the party makes noise in the yard, Wick the dog-handler arrives from the wheel room within a few turns and the encounter in Scene 3 begins on alert.

branches.description: Enter the wheel room through the mill door.

scenes.title: Optional Branch: The Reed Shrine
scenes.summary: A quiet side path offering a calm blessing and a hint toward the cellar.
scenes.readAloud: A ring of leaning stones stands in the reeds, a clay lamp set in the centre. Fresh bread has been left beside it.

branches.description: Return from the reeds to the mill yard.

scenes.title: Scene 3: The Wheel Room
scenes.summary: Wick and his wolfhound guard the sluice lever beside the jammed gear.
scenes.readAloud: Inside, the wheel shaft groans against a jammed gear. Two lanterns burn low. A broad man stands beside the sluice lever with a heavy cudgel, and a wolfhound growls at his heel.
conditions: Once the lever is pulled, the wheel turns and the water in the cellar starts to rise. The party has about five turns to finish the cellar.

branches.description: Descend the narrow stair into the miller's cellar.

scenes.title: Scene 4: The Miller's Cellar
scenes.summary: Aldous Holt sits bound in the rising water, carrying a copy of the sluice lock receipt.
scenes.readAloud: A narrow stair drops into a cold cellar. Water laps at the bottom step. A chair is bolted to the floor, and a thin man sits in it, bound and gagged, blinking at the lantern light.
conditions: If the party stays more than five turns, the water reaches the ceiling and the party must leave without the miller or swim out at a cost.
If the party arrives with Wick as an ally, Aldous speaks freely.

encounters.title: Wick at the Sluice Lever
encounters.description: Wick and his wolfhound guard the sluice lever that frees the jammed gear.
conditions: Begins on alert if the party made noise in the mill yard.

alternativeSolutions.description: Wick and his hound fight until one of them is down or the party retreats. Wick yields if his hound is hurt.
If a character names Tobiah's debt or shows Wick the filed pin, he lowers his cudgel and steps aside.

clues.text: The sluice pin was sabotaged: a lock was fitted to it the week before the miller vanished.
clues.reveals: The mill stoppage was deliberate sabotage rather than an accident.

items.name: Damp Mill Ledger
items.summary: A water-swollen ledger hanging beside the mill door recording a lock fitted to the sluice pin.

items.name: Clay Lamp
items.summary: A clay lamp in the reed shrine that grants a calm blessing for one re-roll.

secrets.text: The sluice pin was filed through from the inside by Tobiah Reed, so that the wheel would jam and the mill would stop.
Wick is owed three months of pay by Tobiah and will switch sides if he hears that Tobiah never meant to pay him.
The shrine's keeper is long dead. Maren leaves the bread there in her father's memory.
Aldous hid in the cellar himself. Tobiah did not take him, and he is bound by his own hand to protect his daughter from a charge of theft.

endings.title: Ending: The Mill Turns
endings.description: The sluice pin was exposed and Tobiah is named. The bailiff cannot sell the mill. Maren keeps her home and the village eats.
conditions: The sluice pin sabotage is exposed and Tobiah Reed is named.

endings.title: Ending: The Water Takes It
endings.description: The party left without exposing Tobiah, or the cellar flooded with the miller inside. The bailiff sells the mill to Tobiah, and Maren leaves the bend for good.
conditions: The party leaves without exposing Tobiah, or the cellar floods with the miller inside.
